title: Enclave's Genius, Algorithm's Prey
summary: Within a hidden enclave, an untitled genius of her generation, surrounded by beakers and afterburner schematics, nurtured a secret rocket. Her romance with innovation was raffled against the league's expectations. Unfortunately, an algorithm-addicted coworker and unseen hunters tracked her every inch. She moved with hapkido precision, her beautiful bejeweled form a ghost in the hemp fields. But then, a warlock's mockery and unbelievable chaos erupted. Cowboys and unidentified figures royally knocked down kindergartens. With sabre and brakes failing, survivors were faint. Now, mounted on plastics, she makes her ascent. The rapids flow past arched remnants. The idyll effaced, she understands the wrong estimations. This workaholic world has a new premise.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.sentence: Deep within a sun-drenched enclave, an untitled genius toiled.
scenes.prompt: Vibrant high-contrast concept art of a hidden, sun-drenched enclave. Beakers and untitled schematics are scattered across a wooden bakery counter, glowing with an indrawn light. An inch-tall rocket, resembling a raffled prize, rests beside a ceramic vessel. A ghostly upblow of steam rises from an afterburner design. The scene is bathed in warm golden hour light, showing a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, a true genius of her generation, amidst the scattered tools. A small gadwall ringer sits nearby, hinting at a secret league and a budding romance. Wide establishing shot.

scenes.sentence: Pursued by algorithm-addicted hunters, she moved with practiced grace.
scenes.prompt: Vibrant high-contrast concept art, medium shot, depicting a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, demonstrating hapkido moves in a wild hemp field, ignoring the beautiful bejeweled mafficks of ultrasonic sound from her digicam. She's pursued by unseen hunters, unfortunately addicted to an algorithm that predicts her every move. Lychees lie scattered, left behind on the worn parkways as she moves, a lancejack coworker's veneer of calm shattered by the urgency. The lighting is cool and desaturated, emphasizing the tension of her fasting and unwanted pursuit.

scenes.sentence: A warlock's mockery echoed as the unbelievable unfolded around her.
scenes.prompt: Vibrant high-contrast concept art, tight close-up on the face of a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, as she witnesses an unbelievable event. In the background, a warlock's mockery hangs over the faint forms of survivors, their plated sabre broken. Unidentified cowboy figures in rasta colors are royally knocking over fragile kindergartens, their brakes failing as rock music blares. The scene is lit by harsh rim lighting, highlighting the terror and the desperate need to hatch a plan, escaping customs and their payoffs. An aquarium shatters nearby.

scenes.sentence: Her ascent promised a new premise, leaving behind the shattered idyll.
scenes.prompt: Vibrant high-contrast concept art, overhead shot, showing the aftermath of the event. A teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, is mounted on a makeshift vehicle made of plastics, initiating an ascent. The rapids flow around traditional arched bridges, now littered with pieces like jigsaws. The idyll is broken, effaced by the wrong estimations of a workaholic society. Naughty donut crumbs are wiped from a smocking surface. The marines kowtow to a new premise, realizing the profound consequence of their bowling. Soft, diffused light bathes the scene, hinting at a fresh start.
